title: Component docs overhaul: primitives to complex widgets (tokens, buttons, tables, charts)
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a consolidated, example-rich set of documentation pages that cover primitives (tokens, spacing, typography, color), core components (Button, Input, Table, Chart), and migration notes for teams updating to the new token and component APIs.

Scope:
- Usage guidelines: clear do/don'ts, pattern examples for common product tasks (forms, lists, dashboards).
- API docs: props, accepted values, keyboard/a11y behaviour, edge cases.
- Migration notes: deterministic mapping from old tokens/props to new ones and automated codemod guidance.
- Examples: React snippets, HTML/CSS fallback, and screenshots/figma links.
- Performance & ops: table virtualization recommendations and runtime chart rendering trade-offs.

Key deliverables:
1) Tokens migration map (CSV + rendered table on docs site). Small sample mapping in this ticket: "old": "new" -> spacing: space-1 -> spacing-xxs, space-2 -> spacing-xs, space-3 -> spacing-sm; colors: chart-primary -> color-interactive-500, chart-accent -> color-accent-400.
2) Button docs page: variants, sizes, states, accessibility matrix, and example code for the recommended prop API. Example prop change: size: ["xs","sm","md","lg"] -> size: ["compact","default","large"] (backwards-compatible aliases included).
3) Table docs: migration guide for pagination/selection APIs: pageSize -> rowsPerPage; selectionMode: "multi"|"single" -> selectionMode: "checkbox"|"row" with clear migration notes. Guidance for virtualization: recommend useVirtualization=true for lists > 250 rows and provide code sample for react-window integration.
4) Chart docs: palette migration, data-encoding guidance, and accessible color presets (color-blind-safe sets). Add note about server-side SVG vs canvas trade-offs for high-series charts.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1 (current cycle): Draft token mapping and component page skeletons; produce codemod prototypes for spacing tokens.
- Week 2: Engineering review for API alignment; iterate examples; generate sample PR that updates a Redwood Console route to new tokens.
- Week 3: Design review & stakeholder sign-off; publish behind feature flag; provide migration checklist to platform teams.
- Week 4: Monitor adoption, collect issues, ship final site.

Dependencies and Links:
- Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/design-system/primitives (design file with updated tokens)
- Confluence PRD: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/DS/Component+Docs+Overhaul
- GitHub codemod prototype: https://github.com/redwood-inference/codemods/tree/main/token-migration

Notes: We should aim to keep examples concise and emphasize safe migration paths (aliases for old names where feasible) rather than forcing immediate breaking changes. For token renames that cannot be aliased, include an automated codemod and a small deprecation banner in the console docs page.
acceptance_criteria: Docs pages for Tokens, Button, Table, Chart are authored and reviewed by Engineering and PM
Migration mapping CSV generated and linked from each component page
At least one codemod (spacing tokens) exists and has been tested on the console repo with a sample PR
Button and Table examples include a11y keyboard matrix and unit-tested examples in storybook
Chart docs include at least two accessible color palettes and performance notes for large series
